shortlist.label: Congestive heart failure
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of NYHA stage III heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and presents with bilateral scrotal and lower extremity edema

shortlist.label: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has alternating QRS complex morphologies and a delta wave present in QRS complex B, consistent with Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome

shortlist.label: Nephrotic syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with bilateral scrotal and lower extremity edema, which could be consistent with nephrotic syndrome

shortlist.label: Chronic venous insufficiency
shortlist.why_kept: Patient presents with bilateral scrotal and lower extremity edema, which could be consistent with chronic venous insufficiency

shortlist.label: Constrictive pericarditis

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of NYHA stage III heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (<25%), bilateral scrotal and lower extremity edema, and elevated brain natriuretic peptide level of 328, which are all consistent with congestive heart failure.

rejected.label: Wolff-Parkinson-White syndrome
rejected.why: Although the ECG shows delta wave and alternating QRS complex morphologies, the primary presentation of bilateral scrotal and lower extremity edema and history of heart failure points more towards congestive heart failure.

rejected.label: Nephrotic syndrome
rejected.why: There is no mention of significant proteinuria or hypoalbuminemia, which are key features of nephrotic syndrome.

rejected.label: Chronic venous insufficiency
rejected.why: While this could explain lower extremity edema, it does not account for the scrotal edema or the patient's broader cardiac history and findings.

rejected.label: Constrictive pericarditis
rejected.why: The transthoracic echocardiogram did not show pericardial effusions, and there is no mention of other diagnostic features such as paradoxical pulse, which is more characteristic of constrictive pericarditis.

gold: Wolff-Parkinson-White (WPW) pattern with heart failure exacerbation
